prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but first a couple quick tips so you get someone qualified and approved by the city:

What to look for
- A certified backflow tester (city/utility-approved). Ask for their tester certification number and the certifying program.
- Experience with your type of device (residential irrigation, commercial double-check, reduced pressure zone, etc.).
- That they will file/send the test report to the City of Liberty (many utilities require that).
- Get a written estimate for any repairs and ask about parts warranties.

Where to find testers near Liberty, MO
- Contact the City of Liberty Water Department/Utility — they often maintain a list of approved or commonly used testers and can confirm filing requirements.
- Local plumbing companies — many licensed plumbers are certified to test and repair backflow devices.
- Sprinkler/irrigation companies — they frequently do residential backflow testing and repairs.
- National plumbing services with local branches (for example, Roto-Rooter and other large services often cover the Kansas City area).

How to search right now
- Google Maps or Yelp: search “backflow testing Liberty MO” or “backflow tester near Liberty MO”.
- Search the Kansas City / Clay County plumbing & irrigation companies and check reviews.
- Ask neighbors or your homeowners association — they often reuse the same local tester.

If you’d like, I can look up specific companies and phone numbers near Liberty (within a given radius). Tell me how far you want to search (Liberty city limits, 10 miles, 25 miles, etc.) and whether this is residential or commercial, and I’ll pull a short list with contact details.
